values.heading: Why Open Editor Platform
values.1.title: An editor you can touch
values.1.body: Fix slides and documents yourself, not only by prompting.
values.2.title: Saved in a native format
values.2.body: Reopen, keep editing, and export to SVG, Markdown, CSV and more.
values.3.title: Open source (AGPLv3)
values.3.body: The source is public. It runs in your own browser, and AGPLv3 allows commercial use under its terms. It is a development preview today.

faq.heading: FAQ
faq.a1: A host-independent editing platform that brings together editors for documents, slides, data, graphs, maps, design and more. AI execution, sign-in and storage services belong to the app that embeds it (the Host). Check supported features and limits in Status and limits.
faq.q2: Can I embed it in my app?
faq.a2: Load the @editor-platform/* packages included in the public repository from an app that uses a bundler. The docs explain how to embed it and what the embedding app is responsible for.
faq.q3: How do I try the Playground? Where is my data saved?
faq.a3: Get the repository and start it with Node.js and npm. Drafts and saved versions stay in that browser's IndexedDB. Clearing the browser's data removes them, so export the artifacts you want to keep in the native format (JSON) as a backup.
faq.q4: Is my content sent to AI?
faq.a4: Open Editor Platform itself calls no AI service and needs no API key. When you combine it with AI, what is sent where depends on the embedding app and how the integration is built. Check the documentation of the app you use.
faq.q5: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.a5: There is an existing preview for Claude Code (v{version}). The docs for that version cover where it saves data, how to install it, permissions and the checked environment. Codex has a reference implementation and no general release. More work on AI host integrations is planned, with no date yet.
faq.q6: What about the license and cost?
faq.a6: It is published under AGPLv3. If you meet its terms, you can use it commercially, sell it or offer it as SaaS, with no license fee to the project. A separate commercial license for use outside the AGPL terms is not offered yet. It is a development preview with no warranty or support.
faq.q7: When can I join the community?
faq.a7: It is in design and has no launch date. We'll announce it on this page when it opens.
